items.problem: CS0579 'Duplicate assembly attribute' flood (×42) from a copied UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs colliding with SDK-auto-generated assembly attributes.
items.evidence: build-output.txt: 42x error CS0579; build-events.jsonl agent: 'This UWP-era AssemblyInfo.cs conflicts with auto-generated attributes. I need to delete it'. lessons.json errors_encountered[0].
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies all .cs files verbatim, including UWP AssemblyInfo.cs. SDK-style WinUI 3 projects set GenerateAssemblyInfo=true and emit the same attributes, so they collide.
items.change: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 now skips any .cs named AssemblyInfo.cs or whose only code lines are assembly-level [assembly: ...] attributes / using directives (Test-IsAssemblyAttributeOnlyCs helper), logging each skip. This removes the collision at the source before the agent ever builds.
items.expected_effect: Migrated tree no longer contains AssemblyInfo.cs; CS0579 does not occur on the first build.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, a grep of build output shows 0 'CS0579' errors and Initialize output logs 'Skipped ...AssemblyInfo.cs (assembly-attribute-only .cs...)'.

items.problem: Same CS0579, plus a CS0111/CS0102/CS0106 duplicate-definition flood from header-only edits leaving duplicated file bodies — no PATTERNS.md guidance for either.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl: 359x CS0111, 127x CS0102, 109x CS0106; agent: 'the edit replaced the header but left the original body intact, duplicating it'. skill-defects.json + skill-coverage-gaps.json.
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' lacks a CS0579 entry and lacks the single-file duplicate-body case (its existing CS0101 entry only covers stale bin/obj).
items.change: Added two 'Common build errors' subsections to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: (a) CS0579 -> delete AssemblyInfo.cs (backstop to the Tier-1 script fix); (b) CS0111/CS0102/CS0106 single-file flood -> replace copied .cs files whole, and overwrite in full when the flood appears.
items.expected_effect: When the agent still hits these errors, it maps them to the right fix immediately instead of diagnosing across many turns.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, if CS0579 or a single-file duplicate-definition flood appears, the agent resolves it in <=1 build cycle (grep PATTERNS.md hit) rather than looping across many files.
